incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: Firefighters are combating a large fire engulfing a wooden structure, with heavy smoke billowing into the sky. The structure appears to be on a grassy slope.

observations.description: Large plume of dark, thick smoke rising from the building.
Bright orange flames visible through the windows and roof of the building.
Signs of fire damage, including a partially collapsed roof and exposed interior beams.
Three firefighters in gear standing on a grassy slope, operating a fire hose.
Trees and foliage visible around the structure and in the foreground.
A fence and power lines visible in the background.
